Name: Secret Marriage
Author: YuuKyow
Description:
功能
①自主选择同居：求婚时可选择让NPC“搬入农场”（正常结婚）或“维持现状”（秘密结婚）。
②秘密结婚：选择秘密结婚后，不举办婚礼、不扩建房屋，NPC保持单身行程，但可解锁其全部婚后剧情。

注意
①使用旧存档前请备份。
②允许同时拥有多位秘密伴侣，但只能拥有一位正宫搬入农场。秘密伴侣在社交面板仍显示为“单身”（有正宫后）或“男/女朋友”。
③与SVE、SDS等大型模组兼容，与多婚Mod的兼容性尚未测试。

[code]﻿[更新]
1.1.0：修复了无法触发有婚姻限制的剧情的问题。但event lookup中嫁/娶某人的条件依旧会显示为红色，实际测试不影响剧情触发。
1.2.0: 与秘密伴侣对话时，鼠标悬停在头像旁边的星星处时，会显示突破上限的好感度，eg.14/10。
1.3.0: 修复了无法让科罗布斯成为秘密伴侣的问题并解除了婚后老水手购买吊坠的限制（但是得点击老水手旁边的区域，否则不会触发购买）。
1.4.0: 增加了i18n。配置菜单适配。秘密伴侣深夜开门。满完美度后，可以选择一位秘密伴侣一同登上山顶了。[/code]
——————

The following content is translated by translation software.

Features
1. Optional Cohabitation
When proposing, you can choose to let the NPC "Move into the farm" (Normal Marriage) or "Stay where they are" (Secret Marriage).
2. Secret Marriage
If you choose "Secret Marriage":There will be no wedding ceremony.No farmhouse expansion (no spouse room added).The NPC keeps their single schedule/routine.However, all post-marriage events (14-heart events) are unlocked.[list]
[/list]Notes
1.Please backup your save file before using this mod on an existing save.
2.Multiple Secret Spouses: You can have multiple secret spouses, but only one "Official" spouse who moves into the farmhouse.
In the Social tab, secret spouses will still appear as "Boyfriend/Girlfriend" (or "Single" if you already have an official spouse).
3.Compatibility: Compatible with large expansion mods like SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) and SDS. Compatibility with other Multiple Spouses mods has not been tested yet.

Update Log
v1.1.0: Fixed an issue where events requiring marriage conditions (e.g., 14-heart events) would not trigger.  In the "Event Lookup" mod, the marriage condition might still appear red, but testing confirms the events will trigger correctly.
v1.2.0: Added a feature to view exact friendship points. When talking to a secret spouse, hover your mouse over their portrait/stars in the dialogue box. It will show the real value (e.g., 3450/3500), confirming that you have broken the 10-heart cap.
v1.3.0: Fixed the issue where Korobus could not become a secret partner and removed the restriction on buying pendants from the old sailor after marriage (but you need to click the area next to the old sailor, otherwise the purchase won't trigger).
v1.4.0: Added i18n. GMCM adapted. The secret partner opens the door late at night. After reaching full perfection, you can choose a secret partner to go to the top of the mountain with you.
